subject.title: fix(openrouter): use dedicated /api/v1/images endpoint for image generation

question: Should this PR publish `endpointPath` as the public Plugin SDK seam for OpenAI-compatible image providers that use a flat endpoint such as OpenRouter `/api/v1/images`?
rationale: The patch is additive and tested, but the option is exported through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/image-generation`, so merging it sets a third-party plugin contract and changes how OpenRouter custom base URLs are targeted.

options.title: Accept `endpointPath` as the SDK seam
options.body: Keep the shared-factory design, treat flat endpoint overrides as supported plugin API, and merge after normal branch/CI gates.

options.title: Keep the endpoint local to OpenRouter
options.body: Remove the public option and implement OpenRouter's `/images` URL handling inside the OpenRouter provider until the SDK contract is designed separately.

options.title: Pause for SDK owner review
options.body: Hold the PR open until a plugin SDK owner decides the permanent helper contract for flat image endpoints.

recommendation.title: Accept `endpointPath` as the SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the shared-factory design, treat flat endpoint overrides as supported plugin API, and merge after normal branch/CI gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is about the shared image helper and public Plugin SDK surface, where this history points most strongly.
